messages:
Elena (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks for the great questions. FWIW, promo window and comp timing details below. Ask here or join office hours tomorrow.
Devon (Eng Manager): Appreciate this. Two quick Qs: 1) if someone's on a performance improvement plan, are they excluded from this cycle? 2) does manager track promotions follow same calibration?
Elena (People Ops): Short answers: 1) PIPs don't automatically exclude someone; exceptions happen case-by-case but managers need to flag PIP folks early so we can review. 2) Manager and IC tracks are calibrated separately but share calibration panel members; different criteria (scope/impact vs IC breadth/depth).
Anita (IC): For clarification — will promotions be retroactive to the start of Q3 if approved? and is there guidance on what evidence to submit?
Elena (People Ops): Yes, approved promos will have retro pay back to the start date of the promo period. Evidence: updated self-review + manager writeup + 3 peer/reference notes. See promo checklist: https://redwood.ai/internal/promo-checklist
Sam (CEO): Thanks Elena — heads-up to managers: please complete calibration rubrics by EOD next Friday. We'll freeze salary recommendations one week after that.
Josh (People Ops Bot): Reminder: Office hours tomorrow 11:00–12:30 PT (Zoom link posted in #all-hands). Calendar invite will go out in 10m. :calendar:
Elena (People Ops): Action items: managers — upload rubrics to the HR portal, notify HR when you submit. ICs — if you want a dry-run, book a 20m slot in my calendar (link in all-hands notes).
